name: 2-Wire Dimmer Switch
notes: Holding the SET button announces the dimmer with an ALL-Link broadcast (flags 0xCF), cmd1 0x01 and cmd2 0x01, the group; holding it again sends cmd1 0x02. An ID Request (cmd1 0x10) gets a plain broadcast with cmd2 0x00.
The SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes list no operating flags readings 0x02 to 0x04, no X10 bytes in the extended Get reply, and no X10 address or retries writes, as an RF-only dimmer would.
In the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes, Set Operating Flags cmd2 0x0C to 0x0F repeat the LED on transmit and resume dim settings, and 0x10, 0x11 and 0x18 to 0x1D aren't used.
The extended Set takes D1 0x00; the SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer Developer Notes say other values are ignored.
